terms.title: Terms of use
terms.scopeBody: These terms apply to the use of the Nicominecith Poster with its music, film and book workshops. The provider is named in the <imprint>legal notice</imprint>. By using the site you accept these terms.
terms.ownContentBody: You are responsible for everything you upload and write onto your poster. That applies to images just as much as to titles, texts and linked addresses. There is no review of the content. Content that infringes the rights of third parties or violates applicable law must not be used.
terms.imageRightsBody: You upload covers, film posters, book covers and other images yourself. You must make sure you hold the rights to them, meaning the image is your own, you have permission to use it, or the use is covered as a private copy under § 53 of the German Copyright Act (UrhG). You may make a private copy only for yourself and your personal circle, not for the public. This site does not obtain third-party covers, film posters or book covers.
terms.textRightsHeading: Text and details taken from other sources
terms.textRightsBody1: The album, film and book search fill your poster with details from third-party sources. Plain facts such as titles, release year, runtime, page count, tracklist, cast or chapter headings are generally free to use. Wikidata's data and MusicBrainz's core data are released under the free CC0 license.
terms.textRightsBody2: Summaries from Wikipedia are licensed under <ccbysa>Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0)</ccbysa>. That is no problem for your private use. If you publish or sell a poster with such a text, you must comply with the license, which among other things means naming the article and the license, marking any shortening, and passing the text on under the same license. For a summary from Wikipedia, the Poster Workshop therefore adds a source credit such as “Wikipedia, “The Hobbit”, shortened · CC BY-SA 4.0” to the poster's info column by default. If you remove it, you may only use the poster privately. Descriptions from Open Library are often publishers' blurbs, and first lines and quotes are excerpts from books and films. Both can be protected by copyright. The quotation right under § 51 UrhG generally does not cover a poster, since it requires a purpose of quotation, meaning an engagement of your own with the quoted text. Without permission such texts are therefore meant for private use only, which is permitted as a private copy under § 53 UrhG.
terms.textRightsBody3: Titles of albums, films and books as well as names of awards, series and characters can be protected as work titles or trademarks. That does not matter for a poster you only make for yourself. If you want to sell it or use it commercially, you must check yourself whether you may use these names. Details are taken over without review and may be incomplete or wrong. No guarantee is given for their accuracy; check them before printing.
terms.usageBody1: What you may do with your poster depends solely on the rights to the content used, not on this site. If you hold the rights to the image and the other content, because they are your own, free to use, or you have a suitable license, you may use the poster without restriction, including commercially: sell it, have it printed, use it in advertising or design it on commission. For text taken from other sources, the section “Text and details taken from other sources” also applies.
terms.usageBody2: If you rely on the private copy instead, the use stays limited to you and your personal circle. Selling, publishing and passing it on to third parties are then not allowed.
terms.liabilityBody: Use is at your own risk. The site is provided without any assurance of constant availability or freedom from errors. Liability for damages arising from its use is limited to intent and gross negligence. If your content infringes the rights of third parties, you indemnify the provider against the resulting claims.
terms.browserBody: The Nicominecith Poster runs entirely in your browser. Your uploaded image, the preview and the finished file are computed on your own device. There is no server that receives, stores or processes your images, and the provider never sees them. What you create leaves your device only if you pass the file on yourself.
terms.servicesBody: For the search your browser queries third-party services directly: Apple's iTunes Search API and MusicBrainz in the music workshop, Wikidata and Wikipedia of the Wikimedia Foundation in the film workshop, and Open Library of the Internet Archive plus Wikidata and Wikipedia in the book workshop. In doing so your search term, your pick and technical connection data such as your IP address are transmitted to the respective provider, whose own terms apply. If you enter your content manually instead of searching, these services are not queried. Their responses can contain references to covers or other images. The application does not load any images from there; your image always comes from your own upload. This site is not affiliated with Apple, the MetaBrainz Foundation, the Wikimedia Foundation or the Internet Archive and is neither operated nor endorsed by them. Wikipedia and Wikidata are trademarks of the Wikimedia Foundation.
terms.spotifyBody1: If you pick the Spotify code for your poster instead of the QR code and enter a valid Spotify link, your browser fetches the image of that code from Spotify directly. Without that choice, Spotify is not queried. What is transmitted in the process is set out under <privacy>privacy</privacy>.
terms.spotifyBody2: The Spotify code, the wordmark and the logo are trademarks of Spotify AB. This site is not connected to Spotify and is neither operated nor endorsed nor reviewed by Spotify. Spotify's own trademark and design guidelines apply to the use of the code. That matters in particular if you sell your poster or show it publicly: the code must then not be altered, nor used in a way that makes it look like an endorsement by Spotify. Whether you may use it in your case is for you to check.

glance.title: 1. Privacy at a glance
glance.generalBody: The following notes give a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data by which you can be personally identified. Detailed information can be found in the further sections of this privacy notice.
glance.controllerBody: The data processing on this website is carried out by the operator of the site. Their contact details are in the section "Note on the responsible body" and in the <imprint>legal notice</imprint>.
glance.collectionBody: This website has no contact form, no sign-up and no user account. Data that you actively give us therefore does not arise. Only technical data is collected, which your browser transmits automatically when the site is opened, such as browser type, operating system and the time of the page view. If you use one of the searches, your browser additionally queries third-party services directly: Apple and MusicBrainz for albums, the Wikimedia Foundation for films, and the Internet Archive and the Wikimedia Foundation for books. For a Spotify code on the poster it queries Spotify. Some of these providers are based in the USA.
glance.purposeHeading: What is your data used for?
glance.purposeBody: The data is collected solely to provide the website in a technically sound manner and to make the album, film and book search possible. There is no analysis of your usage behavior, there are no tracking services, no advertising and no profiling.
glance.rightsBody: You have the right at any time to receive information about the origin, recipients and purpose of your stored personal data free of charge. You also have a right to the rectification or erasure of this data and, under certain circumstances, may request the restriction of processing. You further have a right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority. For any questions about data protection you can contact us at any time.

hosting.title: 2. Hosting
hosting.externalBody: This website is hosted externally. Personal data that arises when the website is opened is stored on the servers of the host. This concerns above all IP addresses as well as meta and communication data. The external hosting takes place in the interest of a secure, fast and efficient provision of the online offering by a professional provider under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The host processes your data only to the extent necessary to fulfil its performance obligations, and follows our instructions in doing so.
hosting.processingBody: A data processing agreement is in place with the provider named above, in the form of the <dpa>Cloud Data Processing Addendum</dpa>. This is a contract prescribed by data protection law which ensures that the personal data of our website visitors is processed only according to our instructions and in compliance with the GDPR. Where a transfer of data to the USA occurs, it is additionally safeguarded by Google LLC's certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

general.title: 3. General information and mandatory disclosures
general.protectionBody: The operator of this site takes the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the statutory data protection provisions and this privacy notice. We point out that data transmission over the internet, for instance when communicating by email, can have security gaps. Complete protection of data against access by third parties is not possible.
general.controllerIntro: The body responsible for the data processing on this website is:
general.controllerDefinition: The responsible body is the natural or legal person who alone or jointly with others decides on the purposes and means of the processing of personal data.
general.retentionBody: Unless a more specific retention period is named in this privacy notice, your personal data stays with us until the purpose for the processing ceases to apply. Since there are neither user accounts nor forms, no permanent data holdings arise on our side at all. If you assert a justified request for erasure, your data will be deleted, unless other legally permissible grounds for storing it exist, such as statutory retention periods. In the latter case the erasure takes place once those grounds cease to apply.
general.legalBasisBody: The processing on this website relies on our legitimate interest in a technically sound, secure provision of the website and in the album, film and book search under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Where data is required to fulfil a legal obligation, we process it on the basis of Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. We do not obtain consent, because the site sets no cookies and does not access information on your device that would require consent under § 25(1) TDDDG. No contracts are concluded through this site.
general.recipientsBody: We pass personal data to external bodies only where we are legally obliged to do so, where we have a legitimate interest in passing it on under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, or where some other legal basis permits it. Where processors are used, this happens only on the basis of a valid data processing agreement. Recipients are the host named above, and if you use the album search, Apple and the MetaBrainz Foundation, if you use the film search, the Wikimedia Foundation, if you use the book search, the Internet Archive and the Wikimedia Foundation, and if you put a Spotify code on your poster, Spotify, each of which your browser then queries directly.
general.objectionHeading: Right to object under Art. 21 GDPR
general.objectionBody1: Where the data processing takes place on the basis of Art. 6(1)(e) or (f) GDPR, you have the right at any time to object to the processing of your personal data on grounds arising from your particular situation. This also applies to profiling based on those provisions. The respective legal basis on which a processing operation relies can be found in this privacy notice. If you object, we will no longer process the personal data concerned, unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds for the processing which override your interests, rights and freedoms, or the processing serves the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims (objection under Art. 21(1) GDPR).
general.objectionBody2: Where your personal data is processed in order to conduct direct marketing, you have the right to object at any time to the processing of personal data concerning you for the purpose of such marketing. This also applies to profiling insofar as it is connected with such direct marketing. If you object, your personal data will no longer be used for the purpose of direct marketing (objection under Art. 21(2) GDPR). Direct marketing does not take place on this website.
general.complaintHeading: Right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority
general.complaintBody: In the event of infringements of the GDPR, data subjects have a right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the member state of their habitual residence, their place of work or the place of the alleged infringement. This right to complain exists without prejudice to any other administrative or judicial remedies.
general.portabilityBody: You have the right to have data that we process automatically on the basis of your consent or in performance of a contract handed over to you or to a third party in a common, machine-readable format. Where you request the direct transfer of the data to another controller, this happens only insofar as it is technically feasible.
general.accessBody: Within the scope of the applicable statutory provisions you have the right at any time to free information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients and the purpose of the data processing, and where applicable a right to the rectification or erasure of this data. For this and for further questions on the subject of personal data you can contact us at any time.
general.restrictionIntro: You have the right to request the restriction of the processing of your personal data. This right exists in the following cases:
general.restrictionAccuracy: If you contest the accuracy of the personal data we hold about you, we usually need time to check this. For the duration of the check you have the right to request the restriction of processing.
general.restrictionUnlawful: If the processing of your personal data happened or is happening unlawfully, you can request the restriction of processing instead of erasure.
general.restrictionClaims: If we no longer need your personal data but you need it to exercise, defend or establish legal claims, you can request the restriction of processing instead of erasure.
general.restrictionObjection: If you have lodged an objection under Art. 21(1) GDPR, your interests and ours have to be weighed against each other. As long as it has not been determined whose interests prevail, you have the right to request the restriction of processing.
general.restrictionOutro: If you have restricted the processing of your personal data, that data may, apart from being stored, be processed only with your consent or for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims, or for the protection of the rights of another natural or legal person, or on grounds of an important public interest of the European Union or a member state.
general.sslBody: For security reasons and to protect the transmission of confidential content, this site uses SSL or TLS encryption. You recognize an encrypted connection by the browser's address bar switching from "http://" to "https://" and by the lock symbol in your browser bar. When encryption is active, the data you transmit to us cannot be read by third parties.

collection.title: 4. Data collection on this website
collection.logsIntro: The provider of the pages automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser transmits automatically. These are usually:
collection.logsOutro: This data is not merged with other data sources. It is collected on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The operator of the website has a legitimate interest in the technically sound presentation and the optimization of the website, and the server log files have to be collected for that. The data is stored for a limited period.
collection.browserBody: The Nicominecith Poster runs entirely in your browser. Your uploaded image, whether cover, film poster or book cover, the preview and the finished file are computed on your device only. Images are not transmitted to a server, not stored and not analyzed. The QR code is generated on your device as well. There are no user accounts, no analytics or tracking services and no advertising. Fonts are part of the application and are not fetched from a third-party server.
collection.searchHeading: Album search via Apple and MusicBrainz
collection.searchBody: When you search for an album, your browser queries two third-party services directly: Apple's iTunes Search API and MusicBrainz of the MetaBrainz Foundation. Your search term and technical connection data such as your IP address are transmitted. These providers are based in the USA, so a transfer there may occur. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in the search function under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. If you enter your content manually instead, the services are not queried. Only text is taken over. The responses can contain references to cover images, which the application neither reads out nor loads; your cover always comes from your own upload. The terms of <apple>Apple</apple> and <metabrainz>MetaBrainz</metabrainz> apply.
collection.filmSearchHeading: Film search via Wikidata and Wikipedia
collection.filmSearchBody: If you search for a film or series in the film workshop, your browser queries the Wikidata query service (query.wikidata.org) directly. When you pick a hit, it loads title, release date, runtime, director and other crew, cast, awards, genre, country of origin, age rating, source material and filming locations from there, and then the plot from the matching article of the German or English Wikipedia (de.wikipedia.org or en.wikipedia.org). Your search term, the chosen film, the selected language and technical connection data such as your IP address are transmitted. Both services are provided by the Wikimedia Foundation, 1 Montgomery Street, Suite 1600, San Francisco, CA 94104, USA. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in the search function under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. If you enter your content manually instead, these services are not queried. Only text is taken over; the application never loads film posters or other images, your picture always comes from your own upload. The <wikimedia>Wikimedia Foundation</wikimedia>'s terms apply.
collection.bookSearchHeading: Book search via Open Library, Wikidata and Wikipedia
collection.bookSearchBody: If you search for a book in the book workshop, your browser queries Open Library (openlibrary.org) directly. When you pick a hit, it loads the work, its editions (for title, publisher, page count and table of contents) and a list of other works by the same author from there. It also asks Wikidata (query.wikidata.org) for title, publication date, characters, settings, genre, form, series, first line and notable other works, and the German or English Wikipedia (de.wikipedia.org or en.wikipedia.org) for the plot. Your search term, the chosen book, the selected language and technical connection data such as your IP address are transmitted. Open Library is provided by the Internet Archive, 300 Funston Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94118, USA, Wikidata and Wikipedia by the Wikimedia Foundation, also in San Francisco. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in the search function under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. If you enter your content manually instead, these services are not queried. Only text is taken over; the application never loads book covers, your picture always comes from your own upload. The terms of the <archive>Internet Archive</archive> and the <wikimedia>Wikimedia Foundation</wikimedia> apply.
collection.transferBody: Apple, the MetaBrainz Foundation, the Wikimedia Foundation and the Internet Archive are based in the USA, and Spotify may transfer data there. If you use one of the searches or the Spotify code, your browser connects to these providers itself, and the data named above is transferred to the USA. For the USA there is an adequacy decision of the EU Commission only for companies certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. You can check whether a provider is certified in the <dpf>official list</dpf>. If it is not, the USA does not offer a level of data protection equivalent to EU law, and US authorities could access the data. The transfer only happens when you trigger the respective function yourself. To avoid it, enter your content manually and stick with the QR code.
collection.spotifyBody: Instead of a QR code, your poster can carry a Spotify code. If you choose that and enter a valid Spotify link, your browser loads the image of the code straight from scannables.scdn.co, a server run by Spotify. Transmitted in the process are the link, meaning which album, song or playlist is meant, and technical connection data such as your IP address. The provider is Spotify AB, Regeringsgatan 19, 111 53 Stockholm, Sweden, which may also transfer data to the USA. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in this design option under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. As long as you stay with the QR code or no valid link is entered, Spotify is not queried. Your cover is not transmitted. The terms of <spotify>Spotify</spotify> apply.
collection.storageBody: This site sets no cookies and stores nothing in your browser's local storage. Your settings, your language choice, your image and your search results only live in memory and are gone once the page is reloaded. Nothing is stored when you switch between the music, film and book workshops either.

meta.title: 5. Last updated and source
meta.sourceBody: This privacy notice is based in part on a template by <erecht24>eRecht24</erecht24> and has been adapted to how this website actually works.

legal.unconfigured: No operator details are configured for this instance of the Nicominecith Poster. Whoever runs it is responsible for it, not the authors of its source code.
